Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the question. It treated “in between The Bears and I and Oceans” as a request to find a separate film released chronologically between those two titles, instead of recognizing it as a binary choice asking which of the two was released on July 31, 1974 by Buena Vista Distribution. This misframing led the process toward searching for an intermediate title (e.g., The Island at the Top of the World) rather than directly answering “The Bears and I.”
